output_contract.raw_fields: Full scientific data stay on the runner. Observe each whole NPZ byte size and SHA-256.
output_contract.live: the latest actual small stdout JSON line and complete per-candidate summary when available
output_contract.complete_log: every scientific stdout/stderr byte remains in the runner log with a final length and SHA
output_contract.publication: notes/run38-bent-disk-killing-<actual_run>-<actual_attempt>.json and its own H marker after normal pull/rebase and capacity accounting
output_contract.normal_exhaustion_or_unsatisfied_targets: No conclusion of metric, reach, grip, global embedding or rigid-quotient success is inferred from the return code

direct_input_lineage: Only this immutable public worktree and the complete Run38 mathematical parameters determine the initial fields. The coordinate arrays from Runs36/37 and their optimization results are not inputs.
mathematical_boundary: A finite sampled Lie derivative, normalized angular period and fixed-target numerical residual remain working quantities. The full physical flow, global Gram, closed embedding, reach, held, Euclidean quotient and converging fixed-metric family need independent arguments or enclosures for the exact same field.
